text: 51-year-old woman. speaker: Doctor
text:
The bronchoscopy is normal, which helps rule out endobronchial lesions. The Chest X-ray showing irregular right middle lobe opacities and diffuse airway thickening, combined with your 11-year history of productive cough and recurrent "bronchitis" in a non-smoker, is highly suggestive of bronchiectasis or possibly a localized form of chronic aspiration.
